text:
emily: Heads-up: the team-setup quickstart tries to grant a role to a group via the SDK but it fails. The README shows a curl that POSTs to /admin/roles:grant with `granted_to: [ { type: 'group', id: 'eng-team' } ]` but Node SDK only has `sdk.admin.roles.grant({ role, user_id })`.

rafael: Oof. Do we have an error trace?

emily: Only thing we see is the sampleapp console: `TypeError: sdk.admin.roles.grant is not a function` after importing the SDK. But when we switched to the Python SDK it had `grant_to` supporting arrays.

priya: Two separate issues here: 1) Node SDK missing the new admin surface for role grants to groups; 2) docs referencing the batch/grant_to array shape that only Python SDK supports. We likely added feature in one client and forgot others.

sam: Can you paste the quickstart snippet?

emily: Sure:```js
// quickstart team-setup
await sdk.admin.roles.grant({
  role: 'project-admin',
  granted_to: [{ type: 'group', id: 'eng-team' }]
})
```

rafael: Looks like Node SDK predates the `granted_to` shape. Current impl only accepts `user_id` param. That explains the TypeError if path doesn't exist. Why not a function? Did we rename the module?

priya: I grepped the repo: Node SDK has `admin.roles.assign(userId, role)` under `admin.roles.assign` but not `grant`. Python has `grant` and supports arrays. Inconsistent naming and param shapes across SDKs.

sam: Proposed plan: 1) Add `admin.roles.grant({ role, granted_to })` to Node SDK as an alias that supports array shapes and maps to POST /admin/roles:grant. 2) Deprecate old `assign()` in docs but keep alias for compatibility. 3) Add a lint/integration test that runs quickstart flows against each SDK and fails CI if any discrepancy of public surface exists.

emily: For quickstart immediate fix I'm switching to REST fallback:```js
await fetch(`${API_BASE}/admin/roles:grant`, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ role: 'project-admin', granted_to: [{ type: 'group', id: 'eng-team' }] })
})
```

rafael: Also add an SDK-level validation: if `granted_to` is provided and contains groups, ensure the client has proper admin scope and throw a helpful error if not. We saw flaky 403s when sampleapp ran under non-admin token.

priya: I'll open a Node SDK PR that implements `admin.roles.grant`, accepts both single-object and array, and maps aliases (`assign(user, role)` -> legacy). I'll include unit tests that mirror the Python shape.

sam: Also create a devex issue to audit other admin endpoints for parity (teams, bindings, policies). We keep running into these one-off drift bugs.

devex-bot: Created issue #834: "Node SDK admin.roles.grant parity (support granted_to array + alias assign)" assigned to @priya. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/834 :eyes:

emily: Thanks — deploying REST fallback now so onboarding doesn't block. Will remove once PR merges and we bump the SDK in quickstart.

priya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/901  adds admin.roles.grant + tests and an integration check. Requesting review from @rafael and @sam.

sam: Great. After merge, let's update the quickstart README to use the SDK helper (and show the REST snippet as fallback). Also add the SDK parity integration job to CI.
